baslik: Amukanlı Nabû-mukin-zeri Babil tahtını ele geçirdi
metin: The second year: Nabû-nadin-zeri was killed in a rebellion. For two years Nabû-nadin-zeri ruled Babylon. Nabû-šuma-ukin, a district officer and leader of the rebellion, ascended the throne. For one month and two days, Nabû-šuma-ukin ruled Babylon. Nabû-mukin-zeri, the Amukanite, removed him from the throne and seized the throne for himself.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/ | ABC 1 i.14-18 | 'Nabû-mukin-zeri, the Amukanite, removed him from the throne and seized the throne for himself'

baslik: III. Tiglat-pileser Babil'i aldı ve kral oldu
metin: The third year of Nabû-mukin-zeri: Tiglath-pileser, having come down to Akkad, ravaged Bit-Amukanu and captured Nabû-mukin-zeri. For three years Nabû-mukin-zeri ruled Babylon. Tiglath-pileser ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/ | ABC 1 i.19-23 | 'ravaged Bit-Amukanu and captured Nabû-mukin-zeri ... Tiglath-pileser ascended the throne in Babylon' ; eponim [729/728]: 'the king took the hand of Bêl'

metin: On the twelfth day of the month Tebêtu, Sargon ascended the throne in Assyria. In the month Nisannu, Marduk-apla-iddina ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/ | ABC 1 i.31-32 | 'In the month Nisannu, Marduk-apla-iddina ascended the throne in Babylon'

baslik: II. Sargon Babil'i aldı; Marduk-apla-iddina Elam'a kaçtı
metin: The twelfth year of Marduk-apla-iddina: Sargon went down to Akkad and did battle against Marduk-apla-iddina. Marduk-apla-iddina retreated before him and fled to Elam. For twelve years Marduk-apla-iddina ruled Babylon. Sargon ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.1-5 | 'fled to Elam ... Sargon ascended the throne in Babylon' ; eponim [710/709]: 'campaign against Bit-zeri ... the king stayed in Kiš'

kaynak: https://www.livius.org/articles/concept/limmu/limmu-list-858-699-bce/ | Eponim kroniği, yıl [707/706] | 'Dur-Yakin was destroyed'

baslik: Sanherib Kiš'te Marduk-apla-iddina'yı yendi; Bel-ibni Babil tahtına
metin: The second year of Sennacherib, he went down to Akkad. Before Kiš, he joined battle with Marduk-apla-iddina. Before him, Marduk-apla-iddina retreated and fled to Guzummanu. In Babylon, Sennacherib entered the palace of Marduk-apla-iddina and the royal treasury [...] he plundered ... Larak and Sarrabanu he took. When he withdrew, Sennacherib put Bêl-ibni on the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.12-23 | 'Sennacherib put Bêl-ibni on the throne in Babylon'

baslik: Sanherib Bel-ibni'yi indirdi; Aššur-nadin-šumi Babil kralı
metin: The third year of Bêl-ibni: Sennacherib, to Akkad he went down and plundered Akkad. He led away to Assyria Bêl-ibni and his officers. For three years Bêl-ibni ruled Babylon. Sennacherib, Aššur-nadin-šumi, his son, he put on the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.26-31 | 'Aššur-nadin-šumi, his son, he put on the throne in Babylon' ; eponim [700/699] Aššur-nadin-šumi anılır

baslik: Elam Sippar'a girdi; Aššur-nadin-šumi esir; Nergal-ušezib tahta
metin: Afterwards, Hallušu-Inšušinak, king of Elam, marched to Akkad and entered Sippar at the end of the month Tašrîtu. He slaughtered its inhabitants. Šamaš did not go out of Ebabbar. Aššur-nadin-šumni was taken prisoner and transported to Elam. For six years, Aššur-nadin-šumni ruled Babylon. The king of Elam put Nergal-ušezib in Babylon on the throne. He effected an Assyrian retreat.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.36-45 (6. yıl Aššur-nadin-šumi = 694/693) | 'The king of Elam put Nergal-ušezib in Babylon on the throne'

metin: The first year of Nergal-ušezib: On the sixteenth day of the month Du'ûzu Nergal-ušezib captured Nippur, plundered and sacked it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.ii/ | ABC 1 ii.46-47 | 'Nergal-ušezib captured Nippur, plundered and sacked it' (polity: Elam'ın Babil'e koyduğu kral; dataset id'si nippur için hedef)

metin: Nergal-ušezib in the district of Nippur on the seventh day of the month Tašrîtu did battle against the army of Assyria. He was taken prisoner in the battlefield and transported to Assyria. For one year - precisely: six months - Nergal-ušezib ruled Babylon. ... Mušezib-Marduk ascended the throne in Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.iii/ | ABC 1 iii.3-12 | 'He was taken prisoner in the battlefield and transported to Assyria' (gün -01-02 sadece sıralama için; kesinlik yıl)

metin: The fourth year of Mušezib-Marduk: ... On the first day of the month Kislîmu the city of Babylon was captured. Mušezib-Marduk was taken prisoner and transported to Assyria. For four years, Mušezib-Marduk ruled Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1.iii/ | ABC 1 iii.19-24 | 'On the first day of the month Kislîmu the city of Babylon was captured'

baslik: Deniz Ülkesi: isyancı vali kaçtı; Na'id-Marduk vali atandı
metin: [The first year of the reign of Esarhaddon, Nabû-zer-kitti-lišir, governor of the Sealand, having come upstream, set up camp before Ur but did not take the city. He fled before the officers of Assyria and reached Elam. In Elam] the king of Elam [captured and executed him. Es]arhaddon named his brother Na'id-Marduk governor of the Sealand.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-14-esarhaddon-chronicle/ | ABC 14, 1-5 (ayrıca ABC 1 iii.39-42) | 'Esarhaddon named his brother Na'id-Marduk governor of the Sealand'

metin: The second year: the major-domo conscripted troops in Akkad. In that same year Arza was captured and sacked. The people were ransomed, the king and his son were taken prisoner.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-14-esarhaddon-chronicle/ | ABC 14, 9-11 | 'Arza was captured and sacked ... the king and his son were taken prisoner'

metin: The fifth year: On the second day of the month Tašrîtu the army of Assyria captured Baza.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1-2/ | ABC 1 iv.5-6 | 'the army of Assyria captured Baza'

metin: The eighth year: On the sixth day of the month Addaru the king's wife died. On the eighteenth day of the month Addaru the army of Assyria captured Šubria and sacked it.

metin: The tenth year: In the month Nisannu the army of Assyria marched to Egypt ... On the third, sixteenth and eighteenth days of the month Du'uzu - three times - there was a massacre in Egypt. It was sacked and its gods were abducted. On the twenty-second day Memphis, the royal city, was captured and abandoned by its king. The king's son and brother were taken prisoner.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-1-from-nabu-nasir-to-samas-suma-ukin/abc-1-2/ | ABC 1 iv.23-28 | 'On the twenty-second day Memphis, the royal city, was captured'

metin: The accession year of Šamaš-šuma-ukin: ... In that same year Kirbitu was taken and its king captured.

metin: The seventeenth year: On the ninth day of the intercalary month Ulûlu, Šamaš-šuma-ukin mustered an army, marched to Cuthah and took the city. He defeated the army of Assyria and the Cutheans. He captured the statue of Nergal and took it to Babylon.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-15-samas-suma-ukin-chronicle/ | ABC 15, 7-10 | 'marched to Cuthah and took the city' (polity: Šamaš-šuma-ukin'in Babil'i; yeni-babil id'si 626 öncesi ise 'Babil (Šamaš-šuma-ukin)' olarak yazılmalı)

metin: The third year: On the eight day of the month [...] Der rebelled against Assyria.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-2-early-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 2, 29 | 'Der rebelled against Assyria'

baslik: Asur Der'i geri aldı; Nippur'a garnizon
metin: Afterward the king of Assyria went down to Akkad with his troops and took possession of Der; he took out its treasures and had them sent to Nippur. He pursued Itti-ili, ravaged Uruk?, and set up a garrison at Nippur.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-2-early-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 2, 30-32 | 'took possession of Der ... set up a garrison at Nippur'

baslik: Suhu ve Hindanu Nabopolassar'a haraç verdi (bağlılık değişimi)
metin: The tenth year of Nabopolassar: In the month Ajaru, Nabopolassar mustered the army of Akkad and marched along the bank of the Euphrates. The Suheans and Hindaneans did not do battle against him but placed their tribute before him.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y10 (sat. 1-2) | 'The Suheans and Hindaneans did not do battle against him but placed their tribute before him'

metin: On the twelfth of the month Âbu he did battle against the army of Assyria and the army of Assyria retreated before him. He inflicted a major defeat upon Assyria and plundered them extensively. He captured the Manneans, who had come to the Assyrians' aid, and the Assyrian officers. On the same day he captured Gablini.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y10 | 'On the same day he captured Gablini'

baslik: Medler Tarbisu'yu aldı ve Assur'u yıktı
metin: The twelfth year: In the month Âbu the Medes, after they had matched against Nineveh [lacuna], hastened and they captured Tarbisu, a city in the district of Nineveh. They went along the Tigris and encamped against Aššur. They did battle against the city and destroyed it. ... The city was taken.

baslik: Suhu isyanı bastırıldı: Rahilu ve Anat alındı
metin: The thirteenth year: In the month Ajaru the Suheans rebelled against the king of Akkad and became belligerent. The king of Akkad mustered his army and marched to Suhu. On the fourth day of the month Simanu he did battle against Rahi-ilu, a city which is on an island in the middle of the Euphrates and at that time he captured the city. ... he encamped against Anati ... He did battle against the city and captured it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y13 | 'he captured the city ... He did battle against the city and captured it' (fail: yeni-babil)

metin: In the month Arahsamna the king of Akkad took the lead of his army personally and marched against Ruggulitu. He did battle against the city and on the twenty-eighth day of the month Arahsamnu he captured it. He did not leave a single man alive.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y15 | 'on the twenty-eighth day of the month Arahsamnu he captured it'

baslik: Harran Babilliler ve Medler tarafından alındı
metin: In the month Arahsamna the Medes, who had come to the help of the king of Akkad, put their armies together and marched to Harran against Aššur-uballit, who had ascended the throne in Assyria. Fear of the enemy overcame Aššur-uballit and the army of Egypt that had come to help him, and they abandoned the city, and crossed the Euphrates. The king of Akkad reached Harran, fought a battle, and captured the city.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-3-fall-of-nineveh-chronicle/ | ABC 3, Y16 | 'The king of Akkad reached Harran, fought a battle, and captured the city'

metin: In the month Tašrîtu the king of Akkad mustered his army and marched to Kimuhu, which is on the bank of the Euphrates. He crossed the river, did battle against the city, and in the month Kislîmu he captured the city. He sacked it and stationed a garrison of his in it.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-4-late-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 4, 12-15 (19. yıl = 607/606) | 'in the month Kislîmu he captured the city ... stationed a garrison'

metin: The twentieth year: The army of Egypt marched against the garrison of Kimuhu which the king of Akkad had stationed inside. For four months, they laid siege to the city, captured it, and defeated the garrison of the king of Akkad.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-4-late-years-of-nabopolassar/ | ABC 4, 16-18 | 'they laid siege to the city, captured it, and defeated the garrison' (kaybeden: yeni-babil; fail: Mısır)

metin: In the twenty-first year ... Nebuchadnezzar ... marched to Karchemiš which is on the bank of the Euphrates, and crossed the river to go against the Egyptian army which lay in Karchemiš. ... the Babylonian troops overtook and defeated them so that not a single man escaped to his own country. At that time Nebuchadnezzar conquered the whole area of Hamath.
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-5-jerusalem-chronicle/ | ABC 5 obv.1-8 | 'At that time Nebuchadnezzar conquered the whole area of Hamath'

metin: He marched to the city of Aškelon and captured it in the month of Kislîmu. He captured its king and plundered it and carried off spoil from it. He turned the city into a mound and heaps of ruins
kaynak: https://www.livius.org/sources/content/mesopotamian-chronicles-content/abc-5-jerusalem-chronicle/ | ABC 5 obv.18-20 (1. yıl Nebukadnezar = 604/603) | 'He marched to the city of Aškelon and captured it in the month of Kislîmu'

baslik: Kudüs alındı; Babil'in seçtiği kral atandı
metin: In the seventh year, the month of Kislîmu, the king of Akkad mustered his troops, marched to the Hatti-land, and besieged the city of Judah and on the second day of the month of Addaru he seized the city and captured the king. He appointed there a king of his own choice, received its heavy tribute and sent to Babylon.

metin: The third year: ... Neriglissar mustered his army and marched to Hume to oppose him. ... He captured him, seized Ura, and sacked it. ... he captured Kirši, the mighty city, his royal metropolis. He burnt its wall, its palace, and its people. Pitusu, a land in the midst of the ocean, and six thousand combat troops who were stationed in it he captured by means of boats.

metin: In the eponymy of Ilī-emūqāia I marched a second time to the land Hanigalbat. I fought with him at Nasipanu ... I entered the city Iaridu. I reaped the harvest of his land. I regarded the city Saraku as mine (and) heaped up the barley and straw therein.

baslik: Huzirina ele geçirildi; Kaşiyari kentleri teslim
metin: In the eponymy of Ninuaiia I marched a third time to the land Hanigalbat. I captured the city Huzirina ... The (people of) the cities at the foot of Mount Kasiiari, which Mamli the Temannu had captured, submitted to me. I regarded his palaces as mine.
kaynak: R2 A.0.99.2 lines 45-48 (Ninuāyu = 899 BC, EL) — "I captured the city Huzirina"

metin: In the eponymy of Likberu I marched a fourth time to the land Hanigalbat ... (I) marched to the city Gidara, which the Aramaeans call Raqammatu ... I entered with force (and) violence the city Raqammatu. That fellow I brought down from his palace ... (and) brought (them) to my city Assur.

baslik: Muşki ülkesinde Pir[u] fethedildi; haraç/angarya konuldu
metin: [...] of the land of the Musku I marched. On the fourth day the city Pīr[u ...] their booty ... [... I] conquered ... I allowed them to remain in possession of their cities (but) imposed [upon] them tribute, tax, [(and) corvee].
kaynak: R2 A.0.100.5 lines 116-127 (885 BC) — "imposed [upon] them tribute, tax, [(and) corvee]"

baslik: Suru (Bit-Halupe): asi bey yakalandı; Azi-ili vali atandı
metin: I approached the city Sūru, which belongs to Bīt-Halupe ... I captured Ahi-iababa, son of a nobody ... I appointed Azi-ili as my own governor over them ... (Thus) have I constantly established my victory and strength over the land Laqu. While I was in the city Sūru I imposed an exceptionally large tribute, tax, and duty upon all the kings of the land Laqu
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 i 69b-99a ('In this same eponymy', 1. palû'nun devamı; kralın eponimi 882'den önce = Aššur-šēzibanni 883 BC, EL) — "I appointed Azi-ili as my own governor over them"

metin: At that time I received the tribute of Haiianu, a man of the city Hindanu — silver, gold, tin, bronze · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-c — Hindanu — bkz. 11
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 i 94-98 (883 BC) — "I received the tribute of Haiianu, a man of the city Hindanu"

metin: In this same eponymy on the twenty-fourth day of the month Ab ... I conquered the cities Atkun, Ushu, Pilazi, (and) 20 cities in their environs ... The troops, as many as had fled from my weapons, came down (and) submitted to me. I imposed upon them corvee.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 i 69b-74 (883 BC) — "came down (and) submitted to me. I imposed upon them corvee"

baslik: Suhu valisi İlu-ibni Ninova'ya haraç getirdi (ilk kez)
metin: In the eponym year of my name ... although at the time of the kings my fathers the governor of the land Suhu had not come to Assyria, Ilu-ibni, governor of the land Suhu, brought to Nineveh to my presence his tribute, silver (and) gold · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-b — Suhu valisi haracı NİNOVA'YA kendisi getirdi, 'atalarım zamanında gelmemişti' ⇒ YENİ ve kurumsal ilişkinin başı ⇒ v:asur DİLİMİ KANITI
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 i 99b-101a (Aššur-nāṣir-apli eponimi = 882 BC, EL) — "the governor of the land Suhu had not come to Assyria"

baslik: Tuşha (Tuşhan) yeniden kuruldu; Asurlular yerleştirildi; Nirbu haraca bağlandı
metin: Moving on from the land Nirbu I approached the city Tushha. I took Tushha in hand for renovation ... A palace for my royal residence I founded inside ... I settled them in the city Tushha. I took over this city for myself ... The rest (of the inhabitants) of the land Nirbu ... came down (and) submitted to me ... I imposed upon their cities more tribute and tax than ever before
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 ii 2b-12a ('In the same eponymy' i 101b = 882 BC) — "I took over this city for myself"

baslik: Bit-Zamani/Şubru/Nirdun ve Nairi kralları haraç verdi; angarya konuldu
metin: While I was in the city Tushha I received tribute from Amme-baʾli, a man of Bīt-Zamani, from Ilī-hite, the Subru, from Labturu, son of Tupusu (of) the land Nirdun ... (and) from the kings of the lands Nairi ... I imposed corvee upon the lands Nairi. · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-c — Nairi krallarından sefer sırasında haraç + angarya yüklendi — tek beyan
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 ii 12b-15a (882 BC) — "I imposed corvee upon the lands Nairi"
harita_degisimi: HARAÇ-ÖLÇÜLEMEDİ (ⓒ — Nairi krallarından sefer sırasında haraç + angarya yüklendi — tek beyan)

baslik: Zamua: Uze/Berutu/Lagalaga fethi; ülke tek yönetim altına alındı
metin: In the eponymy of Aššur-iddin ... I conquered the cities Uze, Berutu, (and) Lagalaga, their fortified cities, together with 100 cities in their environs ... all of the kings of the land Zamua (and) they submitted to me ... I put all of the land under one authority (and) imposed upon them (tribute of) horses, silver, gold, barley, straw, (and) corvee.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 ii 23b-47 (Aššur-iddin = 881 BC, EL) — "I put all of the land under one authority"

baslik: Zamua kralları teslim; Atlila Dur-Aşşur adıyla yeniden kuruldu
metin: In the eponymy of Miqti-adur ... All the kings of the land Zamua took fright ... and they submitted to me. I imposed upon them more tribute and tax than ever before ... the city Atlila which Sibir king of Kardunias had captured ... Ashurnasirpal ... took (this city) in hand for renovation ... founded therein a palace ... I named it Dur-Assur.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 ii 49b-86a (Miqtu-adur = 880 BC, EL) — "I named it Dur-Assur"

baslik: Matiatu fethedildi; halkı yerleştirilip haraca bağlandı
metin: On the first day of the month Sivan, in the eponymy of Ša-ilīma-damqa ... I conquered Matiatu together with its suburbs ... The troops ... submitted to me (and) I settled them in their cities. I imposed upon them stringent tribute, taxes, (and) labourers.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 ii 86b-91a (Ša-ilimma-damqā = 879 BC, EL) — "I imposed upon them stringent tribute, taxes, (and) labourers"

baslik: Labturu'nun Madara kenti teslim; haraç konuldu
metin: I approached the city Madara, the fortified city of Labturu, son of Tupusu ... I received from them property, possessions, (and) sons as hostages ... I imposed upon them tribute, taxes, (and) labourers. · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-c — rehine + haraç yüklendi — vasallık işareti ama tek beyan
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 ii 97b-100a (879 BC) — "I imposed upon them tribute, taxes, (and) labourers"
harita_degisimi: HARAÇ-ÖLÇÜLEMEDİ (ⓒ — rehine + haraç yüklendi — vasallık işareti ama tek beyan)

metin: On the twenty-second day of the month Sivan, in the eponymy of Dagan-bēla-uṣur ... I besieged the city Sūru, the fortified city of Kudurru, governor of the land Suhu ... I conquered the city ... (Thus) I established my victory and strength over the land Suhu ... I erected (it) in the city Sūru.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 iii 1-26a (Dagān-bēlu-uṣur = 878 BC, EL) — "I conquered the city" (aynı pasajda "I razed (and) destroyed the city" de geçiyor)

baslik: Habhu teslim; Asurlu vali atandı; Mallanu alındı
metin: In the eponymy of Šamaš-nūrī ... I took in hand for myself the land Mallanu which is within Mount Arqania ... All of the land Habhu took fright and submitted to me. I took hostages from them (and) appointed a governor of my own over them.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 iii 92b-104 (Šamaš-nūrī = 866 BC, EL) — "appointed a governor of my own over them"

baslik: Damdammusa ve Udu kentleri ele geçirildi
metin: I approached the city Damdammusa, the fortified city of Ilānu, a man of Bīt-Zamani ... I took that city in hand for myself ... I approached the city Udu, the fortified city of Labturu, son of Tupusu ... I took the city in hand [for myself].
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 iii 105-113a (866 BC) — "I took that city in hand for myself"

baslik: Ahunu'nun altı kalesi (Dabigu dahil) ele geçirildi
metin: On the thirteenth day of the month Iyyar, in the eponymy of my own name ... I [besieged] the cities [...]ga, Tagi[...], Surunu, Paripa, Til-Basere, (and) Dabigu, six fortified cities belonging to Ahunu, the man of Bīt-Adini, (and) captured (them).
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 13b-18a (kral eponimi = 857 BC, EC) — "six fortified cities belonging to Ahunu ... (and) captured (them)"; also A.0.102.14 lines 32-35a: "In my second regnal year ... captured the city Dabigu"

baslik: Karkamış: Sazabu alındı; Sangara'ya yıllık haraç
metin: I approached the city Sazabu, a fortified city of Sangara, the Carchemishite. I besieged the city, captured (it) ... All of the kings of the land Hatti ... submitted to me ... I received from Sangara, the Carchemishite, two talents of gold ... I imposed upon him as tribute one mina of gold, one talent of silver ... (and) I receive (it) annually.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 18b-30a (857 BC) — "I imposed upon him as tribute ... (and) I receive (it) annually"

metin: I received from Qalparunda, the Patinean, three talents of gold, 100 talents of silver ... I imposed upon him as annual tribute one talent of silver, two talents of red purple wool, (and) 100 cedar beams · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-b — 'imposed upon him as ANNUAL tribute' ⇒ v:asur DİLİMİ KANITI
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 18b-24a (857 BC) — "I imposed upon him as annual tribute"

metin: I received from Haiianu, the man of Bīt-Gabbari, which is at the foot of the Amanus range ... I imposed upon him as tribute ten minas of silver, 100 cedar beams ... (and) I receive (it) annually in my city, Assur. · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-b — 'I receive (it) ANNUALLY in my city, Assur' ⇒ v:asur DİLİMİ KANITI
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 24b-27a (857 BC) — "I imposed upon him as tribute ten minas of silver"

metin: From Qatazilu, the Kummuhite, I receive annually twenty minas of silver (and) 300 cedar beams. · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-b — 'I receive ANNUALLY' ⇒ v:asur DİLİMİ KANITI
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 29-30a (857 BC) — "I receive annually twenty minas of silver"

baslik: Til-Barsip alındı; Kar-Şalmaneser adı verildi; Asurlular yerleştirildi
metin: On the thirteenth day of the month Iyyar, in the eponymy of Aššur-bēla-kaʾʾin, I moved out from Nineveh ... <approached> the city Til-Barsip, the fortified city of Ahunu, the man of Bīt-Adini, (and) captured (it) ... I seized the cities Til-Barsip, Alligu, [Nappigu], (and) Rugulitu as my royal cities. I settled therein Assyrians (and) founded inside palaces as my royal residences. I renamed Til-Barsip as Kar-Shalmaneser
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 30b-35a (Aššur-bēlu-kaʾʾin = 856 BC, EC) — "I renamed Til-Barsip as Kar-Shalmaneser"; A.0.102.14 lines 35b-44: "In my third regnal year Ahunu ... abandoned the city Til-Barsip"

baslik: Pitru ve Mutkinu geri alındı; Asurlular yerleştirildi
metin: At that time the city (Ana)-Assur-utēr-asbat, which the people of the land Hatti call Pitru (and) which is on the River Sagura ... and the city Mutkinu ... — at the time of Assur-rabi (II), king of Assyria, the king of the Aramaeans had taken (these two cities) away by force — these cities I restored. I settled therein Assyrians.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 35b-40a (856 BC) — "these cities I restored. I settled therein Assyrians"

baslik: Urartu: Aramu'nun kraliyet kenti Arsaşkun alındı
metin: On my return I entered the pass of Alzu (and) captured Alzu, the lands Suhme, Daienu, Tummu, the city Arsaskun, the royal city of Aramu, the Urartian, the land Gilzanu, (and) the city Hubuskia.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 35b-44 ('In my third regnal year' = 856 BC) — "captured ... the city Arsaskun, the royal city of Aramu, the Urartian"

baslik: Ahunu Sitamrat'ta yakalanıp Asur'a götürüldü (Bit-Adini sonu)
metin: In a second year, the eponymy of Aššur-bunaiia-uṣur, I went after him ... they came down (and) submitted to me. I took as my own Ahunu with his troops, chariots, cavalry, (and) rich palace property beyond measure ... brought (it) to my city, Assur. I regarded them as people of my land.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 66b-75a (Aššur-bunāya-uṣur = 855 BC, EC) — "I took as my own Ahunu ... I regarded them as people of my land"

baslik: Zamua: Nikdera ve Nikdeme kentleri alındı
metin: In this same year I crossed Mount Kullar, went down to the interior of the land Zamua, (and) captured the cities of Nikdera, the Idean, and Nikdeme.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 50b-52a (Ahunu yılıyla aynı yıl; A.0.102.2 ii 75b-78a de "In this same year" diyor) = 855 BC — "captured the cities of Nikdera"

metin: In my fifth regnal year I ascended Mount Kasiiari (and) captured fortified cities. I confined Anhitti, the Subraean, to his city (and) received his rich tribute.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 52b-54a ('fifth regnal year' = 854 BC) — "received his rich tribute"

baslik: Balih: Giammu öldürüldü; Sahlala ve Til-şa-turahi'ye girildi
metin: On the fourteenth day of the month Iyyar, in the eponymy of Daiian-Assur ... approached the cities of Giammu on the River Balih ... with their own weapons they killed Giammu, their master. I entered the cities Sahlala and Til-ša-turahi. I took my gods into his palaces
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 78b-81a (Dayyān-Aššur = 853 BC, EC) — "I entered the cities Sahlala and Til-ša-turahi"

baslik: Halab teslim oldu ve haraç verdi
metin: Moving on from the Euphrates I approached Aleppo (Halman). They were afraid to do battle with me (and) submitted to me. I received their tribute of silver (and) gold · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-a — Halab sefer yolunda teslim + haraç, bir kez
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 86b-89a (853 BC) — "(and) submitted to me. I received their tribute"
harita_degisimi: AKIN (HARAÇ ⓐ tek seferlik — Halab sefer yolunda teslim + haraç, bir kez)

metin: Moving on from Aleppo (Halman) I approached cities of Irhulenu, the Hamatite. I captured the cities Adennu, Parga, (and) Argana, his royal cities.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 86b-89a (853 BC) — "I captured the cities Adennu, Parga, (and) Argana"

metin: In my seventh regnal year I marched to the cities of Habinu, the Til-abnian. I captured Til-abni, his fortified city, together with the cities in its environs.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 67-72 ('seventh regnal year' = 852 BC) — "I captured Til-abni, his fortified city"

baslik: Babil iç savaşına müdahale: Me-Turnat alındı
metin: In my eighth regnal year (at the time of) Marduk-zakir-sumi (I), king of Karduniaš, Marduk-bel-usate, his younger brother, rebelled against him (and) they divided the land equally. I marched out to avenge Marduk-zakir-sumi (and) captured the city Me-turnat.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 73-76 ('eighth regnal year' = 851 BC) — "captured the city Me-turnat"

baslik: Kalde kentleri alındı; Kalde kralları haraç verdi
metin: In my ninth regnal year, for a second time, I marched to the land Akkad. I surrounded the city Gannanate ... put to the sword Marduk-bel-usate ... I went down to Chaldaea (and) captured their cities. I received tribute from the kings of Chaldaea.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 77-84 ('ninth regnal year' = 850 BC; Grayson: "ninth regnal year (850 BC)") — "I went down to Chaldaea (and) captured their cities"

metin: In my tenth regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the eighth time. I captured the cities of Sangara, the Carchemishite.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 85-86 ('tenth regnal year' = 849 BC) — "I captured the cities of Sangara, the Carchemishite"

metin: I approached the cities of Aramu (and) captured Arne, his royal city, together with one hundred cities (in its environs).
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 85-86 (849 BC) — "captured Arne, his royal city"

metin: In my eleventh regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the ninth time. I captured cities without number (and) descended to the cities of the people of Hamat. I captured eighty-nine cities.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 87-89a ('eleventh regnal year' = 848 BC) — "I captured eighty-nine cities"

baslik: Urartulu Aramu'nun kentleri Dicle/Fırat kaynağına dek alındı
metin: In my fifteenth regnal year I marched to the land Nairi ... I entered the pass of Mount Tunibunu (and) captured the cities of Aramu, the Urartian, as far as the source of the Tigris (and) as far as the source of the Euphrates.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.10 iii 26-33a ('fifteenth regnal year' = 844 BC) — "captured the cities of Aramu, the Urartian"

baslik: Namri: Marduk-mudammiq kaçtı; yerine Ianzu atandı
metin: In my sixteenth regnal year I crossed the River Zab (and) marched to the land Namri. Marduk-mudammiq, king of the land Namri, ran away to save his life. I brought back to Assyria his property, troops, (and) gods. I appointed to the sovereignty over them Ianzu, a man of Bīt-Hanban.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 93b-95 ('sixteenth regnal year' = 843 BC) — "I appointed to the sovereignty over them Ianzu"

baslik: İsrail kralı Yehu (Omri hanedanı) haraç verdi
metin: In my eighteenth regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the sixteenth time. Hazael of Damascus ... I received tribute from Baʾali-manzeri of Tyre (and) from Jehu (Iaú) of the house of Omri (Humri). · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-a — Yehu haracı, bir kez (sefer)
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.10 iii 45b - iv 15a ('eighteenth regnal year' = 841 BC; Grayson: "eighteenth in 841 BC") — "from Jehu (Iaú) of the house of Omri (Humri)"
harita_degisimi: AKIN (HARAÇ ⓐ tek seferlik — Yehu haracı, bir kez (sefer))

metin: I received tribute from Baʾali-manzeri of Tyre (and) from Jehu (Iaú) of the house of Omri (Humri). · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-c — Sur haracı 841 VE 838'de ⇒ iki sefer mi süreklilik mi ayırt edilemiyor
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.10 iv 10-12 (841 BC) — "I received tribute from Baʾali-manzeri of Tyre"
harita_degisimi: HARAÇ-ÖLÇÜLEMEDİ (ⓒ — Sur haracı 841 VE 838'de ⇒ iki sefer mi süreklilik mi ayırt edilemiyor)

metin: In my twentieth regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the twentieth time (and) went down to the land Que (Qaú). I captured their cities (and) plundered them.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 100b-102a ('twentieth regnal year' = 839 BC; EC 839: "[to Qu]e") — "I captured their cities"

baslik: Hazael'in dört kenti alındı; Sur/Sayda/Gubla haracı
metin: In my twenty-first regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the twenty-first time (and) marched to the cities of Hazael of Damascus. I captured four cities (and) received tribute from the people of the lands Tyre, Sidon, (and) Byblos.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 102b-104a ('twenty-first regnal year' = 838 BC) — "I captured four cities"

metin: In my twenty-second regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the twenty-second time (and) went down to the land Tabal. At that time I received gifts from twenty-four kings of the land Tabal. · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-c — Tabal armağanı 837, haracı 836 ⇒ ardışık iki yıl, süreklilik beyanı yok
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 104b-107a ('twenty-second regnal year' = 837 BC) — "I received gifts from twenty-four kings of the land Tabal"
harita_degisimi: HARAÇ-ÖLÇÜLEMEDİ (ⓒ — Tabal armağanı 837, haracı 836 ⇒ ardışık iki yıl, süreklilik beyanı yok)

baslik: Melidli Lalla'nın Uetas kenti alındı; Tabal haracı
metin: In my twenty-third regnal year I crossed the Euphrates (and) captured Uetas, the fortified city of Lalla, the Melidite. The kings of the land Tabal came to me (and) I received their tribute.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 107b-110a ('twenty-third regnal year' = 836 BC) — "captured Uetas, the fortified city of Lalla, the Melidite"

baslik: Namri kralı Ianzu sürüldü; kaleleri alındı
metin: In my twenty-fourth regnal year ... went down to the land Namri. Ianzu, king of the land Namri ... ran away to save his life. I captured Sihisalah, Bit-Tamul, Bit-Sakki, (and) Bit-Šedi, his fortified cities ... I uprooted Ianzu, the man of Bīt-Haban, together with his rich property ... (and) brought (them) to Assyria.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 110b-126a ('twenty-fourth regnal year' = 835 BC) — "I uprooted Ianzu"

metin: Moving on from the land Namri (120) I received tribute from twenty-seven kings of the land Parsua. · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-a — Parsua 27 kralın haracı, sefer geçişinde bir kez (Parsua 829'da ayrıca fethedildi)
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 119-120 (835 BC) — "I received tribute from twenty-seven kings of the land Parsua"
harita_degisimi: AKIN (HARAÇ ⓐ tek seferlik — Parsua 27 kralın haracı, sefer geçişinde bir kez (Parsua 829'da ayrıca fethedildi))

baslik: Harhar ve Med kentleri alındı; Harhar'a heykel dikildi
metin: Moving on from the land Parsua I went down to the lands Mesu, Media (Amadaiia), Arazias, (and) Harhar, (and) captured the cities Kuakinda, Hazzanabi, Esamul, (and) Kinablila ... (125) I erected my royal statue in the city Harhar.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 121-125 (835 BC) — "captured the cities Kuakinda, Hazzanabi, Esamul, (and) Kinablila" (aynı pasajda kentlerin yıkılıp yakıldığı da yazıyor)

baslik: Bit-Agusi'nin Muru kenti Asur kalesi yapıldı
metin: Upon my return I took over as a fortress for myself Muru, the fortified city of Aramu, the man of Bīt-Agusi. I rebuilt its gateways (and) founded therein a palace as my royal residence.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 126b-131 ('twenty-fifth regnal year' = 834 BC) — "I took over as a fortress for myself Muru"

metin: I crossed the Amanus range (and) went down to the cities of Kate, the Quean (Qaú). I besieged (and) captured Timur, his fortified city.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 126b-131 (834 BC) — "I besieged (and) captured Timur, his fortified city"

baslik: Tanakun teslim; Tarsus'a Kirri kral atandı
metin: In my twenty-sixth regnal year ... I surrounded Tanakun, the fortified city of Tullu ... he came out (and) submitted to me ... I marched to the city Tarsus. (The people) submitted to me ... I appointed Kirri, the brother of Kate, as sovereign over them.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 132-141a ('twenty-sixth regnal year' = 833 BC) — "I appointed Kirri, the brother of Kate, as sovereign over them"

baslik: Patina: gaspçı Surri öldü; yerine Sasi atandı
metin: In my twenty-eighth regnal year ... the people of the land Patinu had killed Lubarna, their lord, (and) appointed Surri, a non-royal person ... Sasi, a man of the land Kurussa, submitted to him* (and) he* appointed (him) to sovereignty over them ... (and) erected (it) in Kinalua (Kunalua), his royal city
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 146b-156a ('twenty-eighth regnal year' = 831 BC) — "he* appointed (him) to sovereignty over them"

baslik: Masaşuru alındı; Sulusunu'ya vergi; Parsua'nın kalanı fethedildi
metin: He captured Masasuru, his royal city, together with the cities in its environs. He* spared Sulusunu ... He* imposed upon him a tax (and) tribute of teams of horses ... He conquered the cities of the rest of the land Parsua, which was insubmissive to Assur
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 159b-174a ('thirtieth regnal year' = 829 BC) — "He conquered the cities of the rest of the land Parsua"

baslik: Musasir'in Zapparia kenti ve 46 kenti alındı
metin: In my thirty-first regnal year ... He* marched to Zapparia, the fortified city of the land Musasir. He captured Zapparia, together with forty-six cities belonging to the people of Musasir.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 174b-180 ('thirty-first regnal year' = 828 BC) — "He captured Zapparia, together with forty-six cities"

baslik: Hindanu fermanla Rasappa valisi Nergal-eriş'in eyaletine bağlandı
metin: The king swears by god that he has entrusted the land Hin[danu ...] to Nergal-ēriš. [No one] may take (it from him) ... Month of Sivan, twenty-fourth day, [eponymy of] Bēl-tarṣi-ilumma, governor [of Calah].
kaynak: R3 A.0.104.9 rev. 19-21a, 34-35 (Bēl-tarṣi-iluma = 797 BC, LV "[797/796] During the eponymy of Bêl-tarsi-iluma, governor of Kalhu"; Grayson A.0.104.6 intro: "in that year Hindanu was added to Nergal-ereš's domain by royal decree (see A.0.104.9)") — "he has entrusted the land Hin[danu ...] to Nergal-ēriš"

metin: I approached the city Kinabu, the fortified city of Hulaiia ... I besieged (and) conquered the city ... I razed, destroyed, (and) burnt the city.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 i 101b-111 (882 BC) — "I razed, destroyed, (and) burnt the city"
harita_degisimi: AKIN (kent fethedildi ama yerle bir edildi; elde tutulduğu belirtilmiyor)

metin: In strife and conflict I besieged (and) conquered the city ... I razed, destroyed, burnt, (and) consumed the city.
kaynak: R2 A.0.101.1 i 113-ii 1 (882 BC) — "I razed, destroyed, burnt, (and) consumed the city"

metin: Moving on from the city Argana I approached the city Qarqar. I razed, destroyed, (and) burned the city Qarqar, his royal city. An alliance had been formed of ... these twelve kings ... I defeated them from the city Qarqar as far as the city Gilzau.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.2 ii 89b-102 (853 BC) — "I razed, destroyed, (and) burned the city Qarqar"
harita_degisimi: AKIN (yıkım + meydan savaşı; toprak el değiştirmedi)

metin: In my twelfth regnal year I crossed the Euphrates for the tenth time, marched to the land Paqarahubunu, and plundered them (the people).
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 89b-90a (847 BC) — "plundered them"

metin: In my thirteenth regnal year I went up to Matietu (and) plundered it.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 90b-91a (846 BC) — "plundered it"

metin: I imprisoned him in Damascus, his royal city, cut down his gardens, (and) burned his shocks. I marched to Mount Hauranu (and) razed, destroyed, burned, (and) plundered cities without number.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.10 iii 45b-iv 7 (841 BC) — "razed, destroyed, burned, (and) plundered cities without number"

metin: In my twenty-ninth regnal year I gave orders (and) sent out (my) army (and) camp. He went up to the land Habhu, razed, destroyed, (and) burned their cities
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 156b-159a (830 BC) — "razed, destroyed, (and) burned their cities"

baslik: Mannalı Udaku Zirtu'yu terk etti; kentleri yıkıldı
metin: Udaku the Mannaean ... abandoned Zirtu, his royal city, (and) ran away to save his life ... He* razed, destroyed, (and) burned his cities.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 164-167 (829 BC) — "He* razed, destroyed, (and) burned his cities"

metin: He* marched as far as the fortresses of the land of the Urartians (and) razed, destroyed, (and) burned fifty of their cities.
kaynak: R3 A.0.102.14 lines 180-181 (828 BC) — "razed, destroyed, (and) burned fifty of their cities"

baslik: Kummuh beyi Uspilulume'ye sınır taşı verildi (Asur himayesi sürüyor)
metin: "On my return (from Damascus) I gave this boundary stone to Uspilulume, king of the Kummuhites." (Pazarcık steli arka yüzü, RIMA 3 A.0.105.1; Grayson: "written in 773 BC"; eponim kroniği 773 "to Damascus") · HARAÇ ≠ DEVİR: HARAC-b — v:asur dilimi KANITI (tanık uzatma, §18); Değişmez 2 ön denetiminde eksik çıktığı için eklendi
